metadata.title: NCP303345 - Integrated Driver and MOSFET with Integrated Current Monitor
metadata.author: onsemi
metadata.subject:
NCP303345 is a smart power stage with a current sense driver, high
side and low side MOSFETs for high current, high frequency DC-DC
buck power conversion applications. The NCP303345 provides an
output signal (IMON), which reports the real-time module current.
NCP303345 operates in a wide input voltage and frequency range.
NCP303345 is a high end DrMOS designed to work in computing
power applications.
NCP303345 of each phase can be operated at its best current balance
and thermal conditions. Flexibility of phase re-assignment and phase
adding/shedding will be considered. As a result, the VR system
situation will be better monitored, properly responded.
